A NEW WEEK OF GOODIES IS COMING YOUR WAY!

Preorders are officially OPEN today and close Thursday night at 6 PM! Get your goodies ordered for pickup this weekend before they’re gone.

This week we’re bringing in some cozy fall flavors, plus a brand-new snack I’m pretty excited about: Crispy Thin Garlic Crackers! They’re crunchy, garlicky, and perfect with artichoke dip, on a charcuterie board, or alongside a nice glass of wine.

Fall flavors are officially here, too! This weekend, you’ll find Pumpkin and Chocolate Chip Pumpkin Loaves, along with our soft Sourdough Dinner Rolls, Chocolate Chip Cookies, Mini Loaf Trios, and plenty more from the menu.

We’ll also have Jalapeño Cheddar Loaves and the sweet Maple Butter Loaf back on the stand! Want something different? Let me know, and we can make custom loaves just for you! 

Sunday, September 27, 2026
8 AM until dusk or SOLD OUT
3101 Applewood St.
Grand Junction, CO 81506

Pre-orders close Thursday at 6 PM, so get those goodies claimed early!

ORDER HERE: https://forms.gle/PLykpGE4xkxrJvpT7
Please take a few to read, then please share! Thank you so much for the support!

🍁✨ WEEKLY SNEAK PEEK — FALL IS HERE! ✨🍁

A new week means a fresh lineup at Blessed Harvest Homestead, and this week we’re welcoming fall with blueberries, apples, chocolate, and TWO new treats! 💛

🫐 Blueberry Cinnamon Rolls
🫐 Keto/Gluten-Free Blueberry Cinnamon Rolls
🍪 Chocolate Chip Cookies
🥨 NEW! Chocolate Covered Pretzel Rods
🍎 Fall is Here! Apple Pie Bars
🌶️🧀 NEW! Zucchini Cheddar Jalapeño Bread 

Sweet, savory, chocolatey, fruity—we’ve got a little something for everyone this weekend!

📅 Open Friday & Saturday

Please take a few moments to read the shared post!

DON’T LET TODAY’S BAKES GO LONELY!

Doughbra’s Stand still has goodies waiting for you, and we’d love to see them find their way to your table!

Fresh sourdough breads, sweet treats, and more are still available today. The stand is tucked safely under the porch by the front door in case of rain, so come on by, follow the signs, and treat yourself!

We’re open until dusk or sold out.

Doughbra’s Stand
3101 Applewood St.
Grand Junction, CO 81506

Every purchase supports my college journey, and I truly can’t thank this community enough for continuing to show up, shop local, and support this little stand of mine.

Come grab your favorites before we close up for the day!

RAIN OR SHINE, THE SOURDOUGH IS OUT AND THE STAND IS OPEN!

Doughbra’s Stand is stocked with fresh-baked goodies and ready for you! If the rain decides to make an appearance today, no worries! We’ve tucked the stand safely under the porch by the front door so you and your bakes can stay nice and dry.

Open NOW from 8 AM until dusk or SOLD OUT!

3101 Applewood St.
Grand Junction, CO 81506

Just follow the signs when you arrive, head up to the porch, and help yourself to some of today’s fresh bakes!

There are LOTS of goodies waiting for you today, but once they’re gone, they’re gone. Come by early for the best selection!

Every loaf, cookie, tortilla, and treat you pick up helps support my little baking adventure and my college journey. I truly appreciate this community continuing to show up for Doughbra’s Stand week after week.

Follow the signs. Find the porch. Grab something delicious.

Happy Sunday and happy sourdough day!
